hero.subtitle: Digital onboarding, AI agents, digital-experience monitoring and security aligned to the SAMA framework, for banks, fintechs and insurers.

context.title: The sector today
context.body: Saudi banks, insurers and fintechs compete on digital experience while meeting strict regulatory expectations. Customers want to open accounts, renew policies and resolve issues on their phone, in Arabic, at any hour.

challenges.title: Digital-first customers
challenges.body: Slow or failed mobile journeys cost customers immediately.

challenges.title: Regulatory expectations
challenges.body: Cybersecurity, data protection and outsourcing rules apply to every new service.

challenges.title: Cost of service
challenges.body: Contact-centre volumes grow faster than budgets.

useCases.title: WhatsApp onboarding
useCases.body: AI agents that collect documents and guide customers through onboarding in Arabic.

useCases.title: Insurance renewals
useCases.body: Proactive reminders, quotes and renewals before policies lapse.

useCases.title: Mobile banking monitoring
useCases.body: Spot slow log-ins and failed payments as they start.

useCases.title: Customer data protection
useCases.body: Watermarking and screen control in branches and back offices.

vision2030.body: A diversified, digital financial sector supports private-sector growth and financial inclusion.

seo.title: Technology for Banking, Financial Services & Insurance | KSA
seo.description: AI onboarding agents, digital-experience monitoring, data-leak protection and SAMA-aligned cybersecurity for Saudi banks, insurers and fintechs.
